QUOTE: Declared scope... "Whole repo, when nothing usable is declared." ... "absent / unusable" ──► whole_repo_scope(root)
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states a declared index_scope is preferred (tool-stated, then .clew.yaml) and that absent, unusable or non-existent roots fall through to whole_repo_scope, which indexes the whole repository.
